searchText: Would it reduce PoS transition risk in any way to have the fork block be somewhat random in its selection? PoS has a mechanism for random number generation, what if we just set it up such that the PoS transition was "sometime after block X" but we used RANDAO to figure out the *exact* block, and the transition would be "sudden". So we wouldn't know when until all of a sudden it was now. (for now lets ignore the engineering costs of this idea, I'm initially just curious if it would *help* at all). how would it help exactly? Consider it a shower thought. 🙂 interesting... the idea is that it might reduce ability to coordinate on miner cartel side? It popped into my head, I figured others would have input on it. Yes, essentially. I would presume if X is known, that we've given a reasonable point of coordination to start You wouldn't know that this was the last PoW block until it was too late. right, maybe it helps with the "last miner" problem but less with cartelization incentives If the window is *large* enough, it may disincentivize cartelization? Hypothetically, if the window was 10 years long, there is little incentive to create a cartel at any point in time because PoW *might* continue on for decades and you don't want to break your revenue stream. If the window is 24 hours, then I agree that it doesn't help with that problem really at all. One of the concerns is keeping devs and community eyes on the system 24/7 looking for the merge event announcement to be there if something goes wrong ah, sorry. I thought you meant that fork block was chosen at X for some time in future Hmm, yeah. It does kind of suck that you could get paged at 4am on a holiday because the merge dice came up snake eyes. instead it will be chosen more dynamically sometime in the future after X Ah, no. It literally is chosen in the moment, and no sooner. turn the dice off during holidays Who decides what is a holiday. 😬 (joke) These are the hard problems. yes maybe a DAO those are hot right now 🤯 you're right, there's a balance here - ie the risk of not being included (which increases closer to the top time mark) vs voting for the wrong thing (which should be .. rare?) I love this idea (personally). 12 months from now turn it on and make it random in the next 12 months? Honestly its terrible for miners though because then we'd basically all try to keep mining to the end.
